message.content: {"caption":"A bordered text panel presents instructions for locally repairing a memory and retrieval strategy.","description":"A wide, pale-gray rectangular panel with a thin blue outline contains left-aligned text. A bold teal heading reads “Prompt 4: Local repair.” Beneath it, a black serif paragraph describes how to revise a memory and retrieval strategy for a training conversation. It says to use only the final aggregate official score and the observed memory/tool artifact summary, while not seeking or retaining held-out evaluation information. It treats official accuracy as the primary objective and cost and token use as secondary, advises against a blanket no-retrieval policy, and favors targeted retrieval over broad dumps when evidence is needed. It also says not to prescribe a fixed tool sequence or hard-coded database queries, and ends by requiring a concise repaired-strategy note under 4,000 characters.","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
